description: Analyze and describe images using NVIDIA NIM vision and multimodal models. Provide an image URL and a prompt/question to get detailed analysis, captioning, or visual Q&A.

image_url.description: URL of the image to analyze

model.description: Vision/multimodal model ID (e.g., meta/llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct, meta/llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct, nvidia/neva-22b, microsoft/phi-3.5-vision-instruct)

prompt.description: Analysis prompt or question about the image (e.g., 'Describe this image', 'What objects are in this image?', 'Extract text from this image')

system_prompt.description: System prompt to guide the analysis

name: analyze_image
